dialect_finding: OpenAlex relevance search degrades badly on long natural-language-ish queries and on the token 'bearing' (resolves to mechanical bearings). Short, terminological, 2-3 token queries work well.

queries.note: FAILED: 'bearing' matched mechanical bearings (bearing fault diagnosis). 1 of 6 vaguely on-topic. Reproduced the failure already observed in the live connectivity test.

W2769728167.title: A Dynamic Event-Triggered Transmission Scheme for Distributed Set-Membership Estimation Over Wireless Sensor Networks
W2769728167.note: Bounding ellipsoidal estimation set guaranteed to contain the true state under unknown-but-bounded (UBB) noise.

W2149371065.title: Recursive state estimation for a set-membership description of uncertainty
W2149371065.note: Foundational set-membership estimation. Energy constraint -> ellipsoid; instantaneous bound -> bounding ellipsoid.

W3004522146.title: Set-membership estimation for linear time-varying descriptor systems

W1896002532.title: Optimal estimation theory for dynamic systems with set membership uncertainty

W2318897747.title: Ellipsoidal state-bounding-based set-membership estimation for linear system with unknown-but-bounded disturbances
W2318897747.note: Minimises the volume of the feasible ellipsoid set - the same metric role that region diameter plays in B problem 1.

W1973654167.title: Improved set-membership estimation approach based on zonotopes and ellipsoids
W1973654167.note: Zonotope representation + P-radius switch criterion. Zonotope algebra is the closest indexed tool to a convex-polygon feasible set.

W2122264639.title: Optimal placement of bearing-only sensors for target localization
W2122264639.note: ACC 2012. FIM + frame theory; two types of optimal placement (regular/irregular); explicit construction algorithms.

W2141276434.title: Optimal sensor placement for target localisation and tracking in 2D and 3D
W2141276434.note: JOURNAL VERSION of arXiv:1210.7397 - same research work, deduplicated.

W1976172966.title: Optimal Placement of Heterogeneous Sensors for Targets with Gaussian Priors
W1976172966.note: Bearing-only among heterogeneous sensor types; arbitrary Gaussian prior; maximises the UPDATED FIM; multi-step sequential placement. Structurally identical to B problem 2.

W2912412749.title: Deep Learning Algorithms for Bearing Fault Diagnostics - A Comprehensive Review

W2091794441.title: Optimal Sensor Placement for Multiple Target Positioning with Range-Only Measurements in Two-Dimensional Scenarios
W2091794441.note: Convex combination of log det FIM across MULTIPLE targets. Objective form transfers to multi-emitter B problem 3.

W2000618191.title: Wireless Sensor Networks for Condition Monitoring in the Railway Industry: A Survey

W2321717374.title: Optimal path planning for DRSSI based localization of an RF source by multiple UAVs
W2321717374.note: UAV + RF source + EKF + CRLB as the path objective; maximises det(FIM) over the NEXT waypoint. Single-step lookahead. Exact structural match to 'choose the next observation point'.

W2043605094.title: Path planning for localization of an RF source by multiple UAVs on the Crammer-Rao Lower Bound
W2043605094.note: Predecessor of W2321717374, same group. Steepest-descent on local CRLB.

W2073444337.title: Overview of the RF source development programme at IPP Garching

W2557998141.title: Recent Advances in Indoor Localization: A Survey on Theoretical Approaches and Applications

W2742299865.title: Localization of sound sources in robotics: A review
W2742299865.note: Also returned in the live connectivity test. Acoustic bearing-only background.

W2166000463.title: Optimization of observer trajectories for bearings-only target localization
W2166000463.note: Canonical: maximise det(FIM) over the observer trajectory subject to state constraints, solved by optimal control / differential inclusion.

W2149154415.title: Bearings-only target localization using total least squares

W1841709236.title: Maximum likelihood methods for bearings-only target localization

W2146065462.title: Relationship Between Geometric Translations and TLS Estimation Bias in Bearings-Only Target Localization
W2146065462.note: Estimator bias depends on where the coordinate origin is placed. B problem fixes the origin at the area centre, so this is a real design caveat.

W2009454421.title: Bearings-only target localization for an acoustical unattended ground sensor network
W2009454421.note: Multiple moving targets, multiple DOA estimates per array, bearings association. Multi-source data association.

W2130160095.title: Target localization from bearings-only observations
W2130160095.note: Explicitly declines to presume random or systematic error distributions; discusses observability. Conceptually the closest indexed work to a non-probabilistic error model.
